$schema: Critical dependencies whose spec/lock/installed alignment is enforced by CI.
description: Edit this list to add or remove packages from the CI drift check. Each entry must be the npm package name as it appears in package.json. The verify:critical-deps script feeds this list into scripts/verify-package-versions.mjs, which produces the same side-by-side report (per-source values, pairwise diagnosis, fix rationale) used for date-fns.
